Well, my sleep has been really strange lately. There have been nights when I only sleep for maybe two or three hours, and I'll wake up way before dawn. But the weird thing is, I don't even feel tired. I'll just get up and feel completely ready to start answering emails or updating the appointment lists for the executives. 

Which is actually kind of helpful, because the new email system they rolled out at work is a complete disaster. They switched us over to this cloud-based platform over the weekend, and it completely wiped out all my custom folder rules. I had everything color-coded by department—marketing was green, finance was blue, HR was yellow. It took me months to get it perfectly organized. And now, every single email just dumps right into the main inbox. It's like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
